# Matching an older object is only a local modification when the plaintext was
# written later. If its mtime is older, it is stale and seal must leave the
# current object alone.

sesam-repo admin base.txt changed.txt

cp $TMPDIR/base.txt s
exec sesam add s --group admin
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'add s'

cp $TMPDIR/changed.txt s
exec sesam seal

# Rewriting the historical content after the object is a local modification.
cp $TMPDIR/base.txt s
exec sesam status
stdout 'M s'
stdout '1 modified'

# The same content with an older mtime is stale.
exec touch -t 200001010000 s
exec sesam status
stdout 'S s'
stdout '1 stale'

exec sesam seal
stderr '1 stale secret was not sealed because it is newer than what is revealed'
exec sesam show .sesam/objects/s.sesam
stdout 'CHANGED'

-- base.txt --
BASE
-- changed.txt --
CHANGED
